items.title: 66960_Gil Evans oral history interview
items.q: And I have to have a trombone player from the, he's now playing at the Blood, Sweat, and Tears too, he's name is Dave Bargerom (Bargerou?).

ctx.x: Well I think he did it at least three times.

How about that. And I have to have a trombone player from the, he's now playing at the Blood, Sweat, and Tears too, he's name is Dave Bargerom (Bargerou?). Now he came from a musical, theatrical family from New England. They had a troupe, I guess the (Bargerou?) family were like a troupe. They played vaudeville a long time ago. Dave was raised in that kind of thing. So it shows in his solos, you know. Sometimes he'll play like a real 1920 style trombone. He heard it playing on records at his parents house. And…
